name: Moonshine

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (broken glass and powdered onyx); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Detect Life
traits.summary: Senses the direction of creatures within 60 ft that aren't Constructs or Undead.
traits.text: The moonshine magically senses the direction of living creatures up to 60 feet away that aren't Constructs or Undead.

traits.name: Ephemeral
traits.text: The moonshine can't wear or carry anything.

traits.name: Illumination
traits.summary: Sheds Bright Light 15 ft and Dim Light another 15 ft.
traits.text: The moonshine sheds Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for 15 feet beyond.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.summary: Moves through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain; 5 (1d10) Force if it ends a turn inside one.
traits.text: The moonshine passes through creatures and objects as though they were Difficult Terrain, and takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Siphon Life

params.who: the moonshine or a creature of its choice

actions.summary: Twice a day: one living creature it sees within 5 ft makes a DC 11 Con save or is Stunned until the end of the moonshine's next turn, and the moonshine or a creature of its choice within 30 ft regains 1d6 Hit Points.

summary: A kindly dead soul who lingers as a lamp: it lights the dark, senses the living, touches for psychic harm and siphons a foe's strength.
